# Ingestion Integrity Requirements Quality Checklist: Phase 3 (003-async-ingestion-cli)

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of specification requirements for CSV sanitization, SQS trace propagation, and deterministic idempotency hashing  
**Created**: 2026-10-19  
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///d:/Coding/Vistarae/specs/003-async-ingestion-cli/spec.md) | **Plan**: [plan.md](file:///d:/Coding/Vistarae/specs/003-async-ingestion-cli/plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. CSV Upload Guardrails & Sanitization Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK001 - Are all spreadsheet formula injection characters (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, `\r`) explicitly enumerated in the sanitization requirements? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-INGEST-007]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the formula prefix neutralization mechanism explicitly specified as prepending a single quote (`'`) rather than stripping characters? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-INGEST-007]
- [x] CHK003 - Are HTML sanitization requirements defined with unambiguous scope across all user-supplied text fields (name, description, address)? [Coverage, Spec §REQ-INGEST-007]
- [x] CHK004 - Is description field truncation quantified with an exact character ceiling (4,000 characters) and specified boundary behavior? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-INGEST-007]
- [x] CHK005 - Are file size ceiling requirements quantified (2,097,152 bytes / 2MB) with explicit RFC 7807 413 Payload Too Large error mapping? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-INGEST-004]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the maximum data row ceiling quantified (2,000 rows excluding headers) with explicit RFC 7807 422 Unprocessable Content error mapping? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-INGEST-005]
- [x] CHK007 - Are acceptable CSV MIME types (`text/csv`, `text/plain`, `application/vnd.ms-excel`) explicitly bounded with RFC 7807 415 error mapping? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-INGEST-006]
- [x] CHK008 - Are requirements specified for edge cases including zero-byte files, binary null bytes (`\x00`), and missing mandatory column headers? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 2. Distributed Tracing & SQS Trace Propagation Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK009 - Are both W3C `traceparent` and AWS X-Ray `X-Amzn-Trace-Id` mandated in SQS `MessageAttributes` during queue dispatch? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-INGEST-010]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the SQS message attribute data type (`String`) explicitly specified for all injected trace and correlation identifiers? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-INGEST-010]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the worker trace extraction mechanism specified into both OpenTelemetry `TraceContext` and `AwsXRayPropagator`? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-WORKER-001]
- [x] CHK012 - Do trace context propagation requirements align with Constitution Principle 7 for cross-boundary messaging? [Consistency, Constitution Principle 7]
- [x] CHK013 - Are directional message logging formats (`MSG: -->|`, `MSG: <--|`) required for local development queue interactions? [Coverage, Constitution Principle 7]
- [x] CHK014 - Is client-forced sampling protection (`Sampled=1`) documented to restrict forced traces to authorized admin contexts? [Non-Functional, Constitution Principle 7]

---

## 3. Idempotency Key Determinism & Record Lifecycle Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK015 - Is the exact composite string format `f"{user_id}:{csv_job_id}:{absolute_row_number}"` specified without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-WORKER-002]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the hashing algorithm strictly mandated as SHA-256 producing a 64-character hexadecimal string? [Determinism, Spec §REQ-WORKER-002]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the 1-based indexing of `absolute_row_number` explicitly defined to preserve original spreadsheet row alignment? [Consistency, Spec §REQ-INGEST-009]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the atomic SQL insertion into `idempotency_keys` specified with `ON CONFLICT (user_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING`? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-WORKER-002]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the skip condition for previously processed rows explicitly defined based on zero affected rows returned by the insertion? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-WORKER-003]
- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for multi-tenant isolation (`WHERE user_id = :current_user_id`) during idempotency queries? [Consistency, Constitution Principle 3]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the 24-hour expiration and background cleanup lifecycle for idempotency records documented? [Lifecycle, Plan §Technical Context]

---

## 4. Partial Batch Failure & Queue Discipline Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK022 - Is 1:1 message partitioning (`IngestRowMessage`) specified so that SQS `batchItemFailures` isolates row-level failures? [Clarity, Spec §REQ-INGEST-009]
- [x] CHK023 - Does the specification distinguish transient retryable errors from permanent row failures recorded in `error_summary`? [Completeness, Spec §REQ-WORKER-010]
- [x] CHK024 - Are primary queue parameters (`VisibilityTimeout: 180s`, `ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20`) consistent across spec, plan, and Docker configs? [Consistency, Constitution Operational Invariant 1]
- [x] CHK025 - Are dead-letter queue (DLQ) redrive policies (`maxReceiveCount: 3`, 14-day retention) consistently specified across artifacts? [Consistency, Constitution Operational Invariant 1]
